caption: The video captures a first-person winter scene where a right hand in a black sleeve holds a lit match against the lower rim of a tilted, rolled birch-bark cylinder bound with a thin twig or wire. The bottom edge of the bark is already producing a small flame as the excerpt opens, so the ignition is underway rather than just starting. The hand keeps the burning match pressed close to that rim through most of the clip. The flame at the bark flickers while the wood glows at its base. Patchy snow, bare twigs and brown dried ferns fill the ground around the cylinder, and the person's jeans-clad knee with a white rectangular object rests at the lower left of the frame. The whole view gradually tilts and rotates, shifting the apparent angle of the bark and the surrounding branches over time. Near the end the hand moves back and the match drifts a little away from the bark while still alight. The bark fire continues to burn as the clip stops, leaving its final outcome unseen.
